activity_summary: After you were done, you said Gaunt the second time, dead by the middle. You had heard the Rose title, The New World's Tragedy, and you did not go. The farewell stayed as the morning had left it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke in the passage after Gaunt's death, and did not go to the Rose.
